description: The FlexMex project deposits input and output data from a comparison of models for flexibility in future electricity systems. Zenodo lists a public ZIP of about 8.4 MB and a README PDF under CC BY 4.0. The provider says input data are separated into scalar and time-series subfolders, while model results are in an output folder. A modeller could use this paired package in power-system simulations to compare how different representations affect flexibility conclusions or test a new implementation against the published runs. It is an experiment archive, not one executable model or a national measured grid record. The landing page does not state the test-system geography, participating models, case horizons, variable units or file counts; it points to the README and publications for those details. The global discovery tag does not assert worldwide coverage. Neither the ZIP nor PDF was downloaded, and no result was reproduced. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this FlexMex model-comparison package. The draft represents the public data collection, not an assurance of independent benchmark quality.
name: Model input and output data of the FlexMex model comparison
